content: Neurodevelopmental treatment (NDT) approaches are specialized therapeutic techniques designed to address the unique motor and functional challenges faced by children with cerebral palsy. These approaches focus on improving postural control, movement patterns, and functional abilities by targeting the underlying neuromuscular impairments. Therapists use hands-on facilitation techniques to guide and support the child’s movements, aiming to normalize muscle tone, enhance motor coordination, and promote more efficient and purposeful movement. The treatment is highly individualized, taking into account the child’s specific needs, developmental level, and functional goals. NDT emphasizes active participation and engagement of the child during therapy sessions to maximize motor learning and carryover of skills into daily activities.
